wsl.permission.warning.title: Turning on WSL
wsl.permission.warning.message: Setup needs your permission once to turn on WSL.
wsl.permission.warning.fix: Run Setup again when you are ready.

wsl.update.failed.title: Updating WSL
wsl.update.failed.message: WSL could not be updated (exit code {exit_code}).
wsl.update.failed.fix: Run Setup again. If it keeps failing, choose Save diagnostics.

setup.generic.failure.title: Cognita Setup could not finish this step
setup.generic.failure.fix: Choose Save diagnostics for support information.

setup.generic.warning.title: Setup needs your attention
setup.generic.warning.fix: Review the details in Setup and choose Save diagnostics if needed.

setup.acceleration.fallback_unavailable.title: Acceleration
setup.acceleration.fallback_unavailable.message: The requested {vendor} GPU is unavailable ({reason}), so Cognita will use the CPU.
setup.acceleration.fallback_unavailable.fix: Cognita can continue using the CPU.

reasons.no_image: this release has no matching GPU image
reasons.driver_unavailable: Linux cannot see the NVIDIA driver
reasons.driver_too_old: the NVIDIA driver is older than 580
reasons.runtime_unavailable: Docker does not know the NVIDIA runtime
reasons.saved_profile: the saved GPU profile can no longer be honored

setup.acceleration.verification_failed.title: Acceleration
setup.acceleration.verification_failed.message: The {vendor} GPU could not be verified. Cognita will use the CPU.
setup.acceleration.verification_failed.fix: Cognita can continue using the CPU.

setup.progress_titles.linger: Setting Cognita to start at sign-in
setup.progress_titles.proof: Running self-tests to verify the installation

setup.folder.control_character.title: Projects folder
setup.folder.control_character.message: The folder path contains a line break, tab, or control character. Choose or rename the folder.

setup.folder.full_path.title: Projects folder
setup.folder.full_path.message: Enter a full path on this PC, such as C:\Users\me\Documents.

setup.folder.local_drive.title: Projects folder
setup.folder.local_drive.message: Choose a folder on a local drive on this PC.

setup.folder.hash_name.title: Projects folder
setup.folder.hash_name.message: Cognita cannot use a folder whose name starts with #. Choose or rename the folder.

setup.folder.drive_root.title: Projects folder
setup.folder.drive_root.message: Choose a folder, not an entire drive.

setup.folder.missing.title: Projects folder
setup.folder.missing.message: That folder does not exist. Choose another folder.

setup.folder.link_unusable.title: Projects folder
setup.folder.link_unusable.message: That folder points to a location Cognita cannot use. Choose another folder.

setup.folder.network_drive.title: Projects folder
setup.folder.network_drive.message: Choose a folder on a local drive; mapped network drives are not supported.

setup.folder.too_long.title: Projects folder
setup.folder.too_long.message: The folder path is longer than Cognita can store (400 characters). Choose a shorter path.

setup.folder.unsupported_characters.title: Projects folder
setup.folder.unsupported_characters.message: The folder path contains $, a double quote, or a # after a space. Choose or rename the folder.

setup.folder.edge_spaces.title: Projects folder
setup.folder.edge_spaces.message: The folder path starts or ends with a space. Choose or rename the folder.

setup.folder.data_overlap.title: Projects folder
setup.folder.data_overlap.message: Choose a folder outside Cognita’s own data folders.

setup.folder.projects_overlap.title: Projects folder
setup.folder.projects_overlap.message: This folder overlaps another projects folder Cognita uses. Choose a folder that neither contains nor sits inside it.

setup.progress.status.title: Setup progress
setup.progress.status.message: Cognita is working on this step.

setup.progress.proof_skipped.title: Self-tests skipped
setup.progress.proof_skipped.message: You stopped the self-tests. Run Setup again later to run them.

setup.folder.invalid_path.title: Projects folder
setup.folder.invalid_path.message: The folder path could not be read. Check it and choose the folder again.

setup.import.virtualization.title: Setting up Cognita’s Linux
setup.import.virtualization.message: WSL could not start a virtual machine.
setup.import.virtualization.fix: Turn on Intel VT-x or AMD-V/SVM in your PC’s BIOS/UEFI settings. On a virtual machine, turn on nested virtualization.

setup.workspace.kvm_unavailable.title: Workspace
setup.workspace.kvm_unavailable.message: This PC’s WSL has no /dev/kvm, so Workspace will be off. Everything else will be installed.
setup.workspace.kvm_unavailable.fix: To use Workspace, turn on virtualization in the BIOS, or nested virtualization on a virtual machine, then run: cognita install --workspace on

setup.tailscale.signature_refused.title: Downloading Tailscale
setup.tailscale.signature_refused.message: The downloaded file is not signed by Tailscale Inc., so it was not run.
setup.tailscale.signature_refused.fix: Install Tailscale yourself from tailscale.com and run this again.

setup.funnel.enable_required.title: Turning on Funnel
setup.funnel.enable_required.message: Your tailnet’s owner must turn on Funnel once. Open this link, turn it on, then press Retry: {link}
setup.funnel.enable_required.fix: Then run this again, or press Retry in Setup.
